test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall verify that the Subject field of the leaf certificate matches the expected value defined in the configuration or provided dynamically.
(subject name not identical to the configuration; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. SAM Dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. Configuration files are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/{TYPE}/cfgs/
proc:
1. Read the Subject field of the certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. PENDING: X-e wrong-subject certificate + trigger
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows a "Subject:" line that is not identical to the subject name in SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/{TYPE}/cfgs/
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. PENDING: X-h log keyword
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
